complete_examples.text: In the climb-derailing process, it is obvious that the wheel flanges will laterally impact the rail side, which causes large wheel–rail lateral impact forces, as shown in Fig. 11(a).
In the present study, typical responses are presented regarding a full climb-derailing process due to large excitations of lateral track irregularities.
